statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-114466 is tracked in GitLab work item https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/812 . Since CVE-2019-1348, git fast-import refuses the export-marks and import-marks features in its input stream unless --allow-unsafe-features is given, but the rewrite-submodules-to and rewrite-submodules-from features and the export-pack-edges option, added later, also take a file path and so let a fast-import stream read from or write to arbitrary files. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is two commits in builtin/fast-import.c that refuse those features and that option in the input stream without --allow-unsafe-features: https://github.com/git/git/commit/2b50a97225c9fa937c4160f7da5132e880fa500f and https://github.com/git/git/commit/19bcf62ed0597b7487c3f4ed2de3c9d97b921de8 . The 2.52.1-r0 build is Alpine's security upgrade to Git 2.52.1, which contains both commits: https://git.alpinelinux.org/aports/commit/?id=2f20de3527863b1b84f620fefe687921498e7240 . We checked /usr/bin/git, the program in the git package that contains fast-import, in both published builds on x86_64 and aarch64. In 2.52.1-r0 it contains the second commit's new message "option '%s' forbidden in input without --allow-unsafe-features"; in 2.52.0-r0 it does not, although both builds contain the older "feature '%s' forbidden in input without --allow-unsafe-features" message. Earlier builds of this owner predate the fix.

CVE-2026-114466 is tracked in GitLab work item https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/812 . Since CVE-2019-1348, git fast-import refuses the export-marks and import-marks features in its input stream unless --allow-unsafe-features is given, but the rewrite-submodules-to and rewrite-submodules-from features and the export-pack-edges option, added later, also take a file path and so let a fast-import stream read from or write to arbitrary files. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is two commits in builtin/fast-import.c that refuse those features and that option in the input stream without --allow-unsafe-features: https://github.com/git/git/commit/2b50a97225c9fa937c4160f7da5132e880fa500f and https://github.com/git/git/commit/19bcf62ed0597b7487c3f4ed2de3c9d97b921de8 . Debian's git 1:2.47.3-0+deb13u1 does not include them, and the Debian tracker lists trixie as vulnerable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-114466 . DHI backports both commits unmodified, and the fixed version is the first build that carries them; its shipped changelog lists the backport. We checked every ELF program in the git package of the two builds in the DHI Debian repository, on amd64 and arm64. In the fixed build /usr/bin/git and /usr/lib/git-core/git, the programs that contain fast-import, contain the second commit's new message "option '%s' forbidden in input without --allow-unsafe-features"; in the build before it no program does, although /usr/bin/git and /usr/lib/git-core/git in both builds contain the older "feature '%s' forbidden in input without --allow-unsafe-features" message. Earlier builds of 2.47.3-0+deb13u1 also predate the backport.
